staticBaseUrl.description: Optional asset base for this component. A non-empty value overrides window.usxBaseUrl in React or STATIC_URL in Django; otherwise the global base or / is used. Asset filenames remain separate.

label.description: Visible text label on the button

tooltipProps.description: Optional Tooltip props passed through unchanged, except label is composed into copy/copied spans. Omit to render only the button. The clipboard button supplies the trigger; Tooltip supplies its own defaults.
